# Preface {.unnumbered}

This book replicates the four applied examples from:

> **"Using did_multiplegt_dyn to Estimate Event-Study Effects in Complex Designs: Overview, and Four Examples Based on Real Datasets"**
> by Clément de Chaisemartin, Diego Ciccia, Felix Knau, Mélitine Malézieux, Doulo Sow, David Arboleda, Romain Angotti, Xavier D'Haultfœuille, Bingxue Li, Henri Fabre & Anzony Quispe (2025)

Each example is replicated in **Stata**, **R**, and **Python** with hardcoded outputs, following the same format as the companion DiD Textbook Translations.

## Datasets

All datasets are available for direct download in three formats:

| Example | Paper | `.dta` | `.RData` | `.parquet` |
|---------|-------|--------|----------|------------|
| 9.1 | Deryugina (2017) | [deryugina_2017.dta](https://github.com/anzonyquispe/did_book/raw/main/did_applied_book/data/deryugina_2017.dta) | [.RData](https://github.com/anzonyquispe/did_book/raw/main/did_applied_book/data/deryugina_2017.RData) | [.parquet](https://github.com/anzonyquispe/did_book/raw/main/did_applied_book/data/deryugina_2017.parquet) |
| 9.2 | East et al. (2023) | [east_et_al_2023.dta](https://github.com/anzonyquispe/did_book/raw/main/did_applied_book/data/east_et_al_2023.dta) | [.RData](https://github.com/anzonyquispe/did_book/raw/main/did_applied_book/data/east_et_al_2023.RData) | [.parquet](https://github.com/anzonyquispe/did_book/raw/main/did_applied_book/data/east_et_al_2023.parquet) |
| 9.3 | Gentzkow et al. (2011) | [gentzkowetal_didtextbook.dta](https://github.com/anzonyquispe/did_book/raw/main/did_applied_book/data/gentzkowetal_didtextbook.dta) | [.RData](https://github.com/anzonyquispe/did_book/raw/main/did_applied_book/data/gentzkowetal_didtextbook.RData) | [.parquet](https://github.com/anzonyquispe/did_book/raw/main/did_applied_book/data/gentzkowetal_didtextbook.parquet) |
| 9.4 | Hollingsworth et al. (2022) | [hollingsworth_et_al_2022.dta](https://github.com/anzonyquispe/did_book/raw/main/did_applied_book/data/hollingsworth_et_al_2022.dta) | [.RData](https://github.com/anzonyquispe/did_book/raw/main/did_applied_book/data/hollingsworth_et_al_2022.RData) | [.parquet](https://github.com/anzonyquispe/did_book/raw/main/did_applied_book/data/hollingsworth_et_al_2022.parquet) |

Alternatively, datasets are bundled with the `did_multiplegt_dyn` Stata package:

```stata
ssc install did_multiplegt_dyn, replace
net get did_multiplegt_dyn
```

## Requirements

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Stata

```stata
ssc install did_multiplegt_dyn, replace
```

### R

```r
install.packages("DIDmultiplegtDYN")
install.packages("polars")   # required backend
install.packages("haven")    # to read .dta files
```

### Python

```python
pip install did-multiplegt-dyn
pip install pandas pyarrow    # to read .parquet files
```

:::

## Source code

All replication scripts are available in the repository:

- **Stata:** `did_applied_book/ch09_applied_examples.do`
- **R:** `did_applied_book/ch09_ex1_deryugina.R`, `ch09_ex2_east.R`, `ch09_ex3_gentzkow.R`, `ch09_ex4_hollingsworth.R`
- **Python:** `did_applied_book/ch09_python_all.py`
